notes: The 'and when' unit on the waw is correct under rule 55, but that rule also asks the head to be hedged: the corpus heads eleven of its twenty-seven 'and when' units on 'when' rather than on the coordinator. Recorded here since the unit note does not name it; the partition itself needs no change.
'lay ... charge' is kept whole on the verb as the English idiom, with 'to' on the written `לְ` and 'her' on its suffix — contrast DEU.22.17, where no such morphemes stand.
The final waw is unrepresented because the ASV opens that clause with no connective.
